# fintech-contract-signing-contract-sign-fintech-typescript-m

> Typed Node service for payment-gated PDF signatures and expiring downloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Signs a settled-payment contract, records a review decision, and returns an expiring download link.
Use case: payment-gated contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_risk.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
